name: Laevisuchus
sum: Small Late Cretaceous theropod from the Lameta Formation of India, named in 1933 from vertebrae.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Remains found by Charles Alfred Matley near Jabalpur in the Maastrichtian Carnosaur Bed.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Huene 1933
